subject: Learning Methods
title: Using Wrong Answers to Find Gaps
description: A quick, practical guide to Using Wrong Answers to Find Gaps.

hook.text: A study found that students who analyzed why wrong answers were wrong learned more than those who only studied correct.

buildup.text: Wrong answers contain diagnostic information. They reveal which misconceptions are active in the learner's mind.

discovery.text: When teaching, ask students to explain not the right answer but why each wrong option is wrong.

twist.text: Teachers who dismiss wrong answers miss a chance. Every error is a window into the learner's current mental model.

climax.text: After any quiz, review every wrong answer. Explain why each is wrong. This strengthens the boundary of your knowledge.

punchline.text: Wrong answers are data. Diagnose them, don't dismiss them.

quiz.question: Why is analyzing wrong answers more valuable than just studying correct ones?
options: Wrong answers are more memorable due to their novelty
They reveal active misconceptions in the learner's thinking
There are usually more wrong answers than correct ones
